integrity: A direct analytic proof and explicit signed-measure witness establish the exact norm; finite checking is supplemental. No independent audit or validation has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Exact for scalar real-output affine maps on the whole real Hilbert input space with signed ReLU measures on the joint Euclidean parameter unit ball; no assertion for arbitrary nonlinear maps, complex fields, free affine skips, compact-domain norm, or other parameter penalties. title: Exact affine ReLU variation norm and its bias–slope transition
